objective: Rank subjects by how strongly the supplied evidence supports the target construct.
subject: Describe the type of entity that will receive a score.
target_definition: Define what a score of 100 should mean in observable terms.
decision_use: Describe the decision, prioritization, or analysis informed by the score.
evidence_description: Describe the documents or text that will be supplied to the scorer.
evidence_exclusions: List claims or signals that must not be treated as functional evidence.

required_dimensions.name: Required capability
required_dimensions.definition: Describe one necessary and independently observable dimension.

optional_signals.name: Explicit self-claim
optional_signals.definition: The subject explicitly claims alignment with the target.

missing_evidence_policy: Treat absence of explicit evidence as uncertainty or low support; do not infer capabilities.
compensation_policy: State whether strong dimensions may compensate for weak dimensions: additive, balanced, strict, or blended bottleneck.
